aircraft--noun.def: Any machine that flies, such as a plane or a helicopter.

embassy--noun.def: The office of a country's ambassador abroad.
embassy--noun.ex: Apply at the embassy in Ankara.

cabinet--noun.def: A cupboard with shelves, or the senior ministers of a government.
cabinet--noun.ex: The files are in the cabinet.

fame--noun.def: The state of being known by many people.

quote--noun.def: Words repeated from a text, or a stated price.
quote--noun.ex: The article opens with a quote.

quote--verb.def: To repeat someone's words, or to state a price.
quote--verb.ex: He quoted a line from the poem.

penalty--noun.def: A punishment, or a free shot at goal in football.
penalty--noun.ex: The penalty for late payment is high.

bargain--verb.def: To discuss a price until both sides agree.

scar--noun.def: The mark left on skin after a wound heals.
scar--noun.ex: He has a scar above his eye.
scar--noun.exTr: Gözünün üstünde bir yara izi var.

rusty--adj.def: Covered with rust, or no longer good through lack of practice.

cruise--verb.def: To travel at a steady comfortable speed.
cruise--verb.ex: The plane cruised above the clouds.
cruise--verb.exTr: Uçak bulutların üstünde seyir hâlinde gitti.

primary--adj.def: Most important, or first in order.

adopted--adj.def: Taken into a family, or chosen and used.

trailer--noun.def: A vehicle pulled behind another, or a short film advertisement.
trailer--noun.ex: The trailer made me want to watch it.
trailer--noun.exTr: Fragman filmi izlemek istememe yol açtı.

ally--noun.def: A country or person that helps another.

cooperate--verb.def: To work together towards the same aim.
cooperate--verb.exTr: İki okul yakın iş birliği yapıyor.

worthless--adj.def: Having no value or use at all.
worthless--adj.ex: The old notes are worthless now.

grip--noun.ex: Keep a firm grip on the rope.

grip--verb.ex: She gripped the rail in fear.

creation--noun.def: The act of making something new.
creation--noun.ex: The creation of the park took years.

certificate--noun.def: An official paper proving a fact or an achievement.

bold--noun.def: Thick dark printing used to make text stand out.

twisted--adj.def: Bent out of shape, or unpleasantly strange.

envy--verb.def: To wish you had what someone else has.

villa--noun.def: A large comfortable house, often in the country.
villa--noun.ex: They rented a villa by the sea.

faint--verb.def: To lose consciousness for a short time.

volunteer--noun.def: A person who offers to work without pay.

perspective--noun.def: A particular way of seeing a situation.
perspective--noun.ex: Try to see it from her perspective.
perspective--noun.exTr: Olaya onun bakış açısından bakmaya çalış.

designer--adj.def: Made by a famous designer and expensive.

sweep--verb.def: To clean a floor with a brush.
sweep--verb.ex: Sweep the yard before the guests come.

risky--adj.def: Involving a chance of loss or danger.

tender--adj.def: Soft and easy to cut, or gentle and loving.

tub--noun.def: A large open container, or a bath.
tub--noun.ex: Fill the tub with warm water.

slight--adj.def: Small in degree and not important.

ritual--noun.def: A set of actions always performed in the same way.
ritual--noun.ex: Morning tea is a family ritual.

so-called--adj.def: Called that name, though it may not deserve it.
so-called--adj.ex: His so called friends never helped.

genuine--adj.def: Real and not a copy, or honest and sincere.

ceiling--noun.def: The upper inside surface of a room.
ceiling--noun.ex: A lamp hangs from the ceiling.

therapist--noun.def: A trained person who treats illness or mental problems.

worship--noun.def: The act of showing respect and love for a god.
worship--noun.ex: The building is used for worship.

residence--noun.def: The house where someone lives, in formal English.

execution--noun.def: The killing of someone as a punishment, or the carrying out of a plan.
execution--noun.ex: The execution of the plan was flawless.

strictly--adv.def: In a way that must be obeyed exactly.

technical--adj.def: Relating to machines, science or a special skill.

deer--noun.def: A wild animal that runs fast and often has antlers.

thrilled--adj.ex: She was thrilled with the news.

consciousness--noun.def: The state of being awake and aware.

bare--verb.def: To uncover something that was covered.

butcher--verb.def: To cut up an animal for meat.
butcher--verb.ex: They butchered the lamb at dawn.

prior--adj.def: Happening or existing before something else.

luxury--adj.ex: They stayed in a luxury hotel.

tomb--noun.def: A large stone structure where a body is buried.
tomb--noun.ex: The tomb dates from the fifteenth century.

broadcast--verb.def: To send out a programme on radio or television.

spray--noun.def: Liquid sent out in very small drops.

spray--verb.def: To send liquid out in small drops.
spray--verb.ex: He sprayed water on the plants.

crawl--verb.def: To move on your hands and knees.
crawl--verb.ex: The baby crawled to the door.

slice--verb.def: To cut something into thin flat pieces.

stiff--adj.def: Hard to bend, or aching after exercise.
stiff--adj.ex: My neck is stiff this morning.

lick--verb.def: To move your tongue over something.
lick--verb.ex: The cat licked the plate clean.

concrete--adj.def: Real and definite rather than general.

concrete--noun.def: A hard building material made of cement and stone.

scheme--noun.def: An official plan, or a secret dishonest plan.
scheme--noun.ex: The council started a housing scheme.

plug--verb.def: To connect to electricity, or to block a hole.
plug--verb.ex: Plug the charger into the wall.

respected--adj.def: Admired by many people for good qualities.

discipline--noun.def: Controlled behaviour, or training that produces it.
discipline--noun.ex: The school is known for discipline.

reed--noun.def: A tall plant that grows in wet ground.

privilege--noun.def: A special right given to one person or group.

scent--noun.def: A pleasant smell, or the smell an animal follows.
scent--noun.ex: The scent of pine filled the air.

ranger--noun.def: A person who looks after a forest or a park.
ranger--noun.ex: A ranger showed us the trail.
ranger--noun.exTr: Bir park görevlisi bize patikayı gösterdi.

plague--noun.def: A serious disease that spreads quickly and kills many.

hush--verb.def: To make someone stop talking or crying.

instinct--noun.def: A natural feeling that tells you how to act.

originally--adv.ex: The building was originally a school.

drain--noun.def: A pipe that carries away waste water.

furious--adj.ex: He was furious about the delay.
